        rj, pj = mapping[j]
        if ri == rj:
            return None
        if routes[ri] is None or routes[rj] is None:
            return None

        if route_load[ri] + route_load[rj] > capacity:
            return None

        r_i = routes[ri]
        r_j = routes[rj]
        if pi == 0 and pj == 0:
            return r_i + r_j[::-1]
        if pi == 0 and pj != 0:

        if pi != 0 and pj == 0:

        return r_i[::-1] + r_j

            j = customers[b]
            dj = demands[j]
            if di + dj <= capacity:
                s = matrix[depot][i] + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
                s_list.append((s, i, j))
